title: Colts get smashed in season opener; where was the "sense of urgency?"
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver recap the Indianapolis Colts' embarrassing season-opening loss to the Baltimore Ravens. Colts owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon said all offseason that the "sense of urgency has never been higher" regarding her team. How come we couldn't feel it in Week 1? And what should that mean for general manager Chris Ballard and coach Shane Steichen? Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
